title: Opus5.5 Low to Max - New Experiment
author: 314t
selftext:
I pitted Opus5.5 low, medium, high, xhigh and max against each other, all using the same prompt without a reference image. All were allowed to use one sub-agent but surprisingly none did.

All were told to build a moody Godot 4.7 diorama of a cyberpunk alley, with rain slicked PBR surface, neon signs, bloom, volumetric fog, SDFGI, tone mapping, tile shift, depth of field, emissive signs, low angle hero shot. All agents were also instructed to use 3D Assets, and not to handroll any (not the actual prompt, just the summary).

| Position | Effort | Build time |

|:--|:--|:--|

| Top left | low | 5m 42s |

| Top centre | medium | 23m 32s |

| Top right | high | 18m 1s |

| Bottom left | xhigh | 42m 10s |

| Bottom centre | max | 1h 35m 22s |

  
Which one do you like?

comments.author: Equivalent_Help_4690
comments.body: What does your pipeline look like? What tools are you using etc?

replies.author: 314t
replies.body:
**Pipeline:**

1. Caffeine  
2. Compiled list of 'impactful' words in a markdown document. (e.g. cinematic, volumetric lighting)   
3. Compiled list of general guidelines in markdown document. (Use existing 3D assets, prefer high poly over low poly, Never Handroll assets on your own, you are allowed to use 1 sub-agent for any task, essentially place prompts to steer away from what you do NOT want, like low poly, I hate low poly.)  
3. Have a general idea, of what you want, in human slop form, spelling mistakes included. ( I want a cyberpunk alley)  
4. Spinup ChatGPT or Claude, give it your human slop prompt, tell it to adapt against your list of impact words, and expand and add detail and use the given guidlines document. 

5. Run it again, and have it adapt to the game engine, e.g Godot 4.7 or Unreal 5.8  
6. Give it to Claude or ChatGPT and let it spin up the agents, setup the folders, and launch each agent in it. 

**Exact Tools:**  
  
Godot 4.7, Unreal 5.8 (game engine)

Blender 5 (3d modeling, tweaks)

Polyhaven (3d assets)

SketchFab (3d assets)

The Internet (IT must always search for an asset if it cannot find it on these other websites)

Muxer (my own vibecoded multiplexing terminal, I do not let claude run subagents, I force it to start an agent in a terminal I can watch. Agents behave differently if they were started by another agent, vs they think they were started by a human.)

replies.author: 314t
replies.body: I've never gotten inherently better results on ultracode for visual tasks over a single agent on high, so usually stay away from ultra code. And it just feels like Anthropic has lowered limits too much that ultracode just feels like burning tokens. I can do another test Low to Ultracode and share the results later.

comments.author: MichaelEmouse
comments.body:
I prefer max but starting with low and iterating with cheaper effort levels before gradually increasing the effort level up to max is probably best.



Why do you think medium took longer than high?

  
The water looks best at high and max but somehow dips in quality at xhigh. 



The walls textures are go from clear to blurry to clear when going from high to xhigh to max. The bloom effect does the same thing.



Note how there are graffitis in high, none in xhigh and they come back in greater quantity and quality at max. 

  
Very instructive. Please make more comparisons like that.
